title: to do 与 doing 义变

examples.en: He stopped to talk to me.

guess.question: 两句都有 stopped，意思有什么不同？

options.text: 第一句是“停下来，去做另一件事”；第二句是“停止正在做的那件事”
options.feedback: 对！to do 指向还没做的事，doing 指向正在做的事。
不对——一个开始说话，一个不再说话，方向正相反。
不对——差别在意思，不在礼貌程度。

left.label: to do：还没做、将要做的
left.formula: stop / remember / forget / try + to do

anchor.en: He stopped to have a rest.

left.focus: 动作在“之后”发生：停下手头的事，去休息

right.label: doing：正在做、已经做过的
right.focus: 动作本身被停止：休息这个动作结束了

contrast.diff: to do 说的是“将来/未做”的动作，doing 说的是“已经发生过”的动作。remember to do 记得去做（还没做），remember doing 记得做过（已做过）；forget 同理；try to do 努力去做，try doing 试着做做看。

traps.wrong: I forgot locking the door, so I went back to check it.
traps.right: I forgot to lock the door, so I went back to check it.
traps.why: 忘了去锁门（没锁）用 forget to do；forget doing 是“忘了自己锁过门”。

traps.wrong: Please remember posting the letter for me.
traps.right: Please remember to post the letter for me.
traps.why: 提醒别人“记得去做”用 remember to do。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——判断口诀：还没做用 to do，已经做过用 doing。

check.stem: Remember ____ (turn) off the light when you leave.

options.distractor: 灯还没关，是“记得去关”，用 to do

check.explanation: 记得去做（还没做）→ remember to turn。

options.distractor: before 说明已经见过，用 doing

check.explanation: 记得做过（已发生）→ remember meeting。

check.stem: 他很累，于是停下来休息一会儿。

options.text: He stopped to have a rest.

options.distractor: 这是“不再休息”，与“很累”矛盾

options.text: He stopped to having a rest.
options.distractor: to 后面要接动词原形

check.explanation: 停下来去做另一件事 → stopped to have a rest。
